identity.annotationCheck: All journal annotations match the declared schedules, compiled profiles and search settings; the parent bytes equal the archived source. Missing extension process manifests cannot be reconstructed as execution evidence.

validation.originalPieceTracking: Tracks original subject tokens through both-color castling, captures and promotions; uses the actual side to move, including Black-to-move starts.

checkpoint.interpretation: The uploaded extension contains later games too. Checkpoint2304Same64 includes only the first 64 declared openings; allUploaded is separate and may contain partial pairs.
